entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angelic protector of Innistrad, released from the Helvault, who rallies her troops to contain the demonic threat.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon released from the Helvault along with numerous others of his kind.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison from which Avacyn, Griselbrand and other demons were released.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane of humanity's struggle against monsters where the set takes place.

entities.name: Tamiyo, the Moon Sage
entities.description: A Moonfolk planeswalker originally from Kamigawa featured in the set.

entities.name: Tibalt, the Fiend-Blooded
entities.description: A human-devil planeswalker featured in the set.

entities.name: Demons
entities.description: The mortal enemies of humans and angels that Avacyn aims to cleanse from Innistrad.

events.summary: Avacyn campaigns to rally her troops to contain the demonic threat and cleanse Innistrad of the infernal creatures.
events.quote: Avacyn Restored shows Avacyn's campaign to rally her troops to contain the demonic threat and, ultimately, to cleanse Innistrad of all these infernal creatures.
